exact_instruction: Also if you ever run AI models on a tiny sample you should run it like 3 times on the exact same thing to see if it behaves consistently.
frozen: generation settings including seed when present
independence: Fresh provider requests; no previous reply as context; cached/journal replay does not count.
report: every raw reply including invalid and uncertain
elapsed time and usage per run and combined
limits: Consistency is not correctness. Preserve existing stopping rules; explain incomplete groups. No reopening spent historical experiments or new launch in this documentation task.
